limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 remain unstarted.
No Files UI, command dispatcher, properties presentation or production mutations implemented.

UI may read immutable pages and atomic stamp.current only; model reads/captures/mutators/accepts require the owning serialized worker.
Page string budget bounds payload bytes; fixed object/row count bounds overhead separately, without exact allocator or real-time latency claims.
No application launched or visual result claimed. Assets were not changed; this milestone builds domain/native test targets only.
Linux fscrypt locked-directory fixture from the preceding milestone was removed; optional native case is unconfigured here and is not counted as new encryption-policy coverage.
Apple leak detection unsupported; disabled only for macOS ASan. Linux ASan includes leak detection; Windows uses ASan, without UBSan/LSan claims.
